title: Submit one bounded read-only MCP tool turn

requires.provider: An existing QA-configured Pi provider; missing model access blocks the case
requires.readOnlyMcp: An existing configured read-only MCP tool with a deterministic response; do not add a server or use CRM mutations
requires.modelTurn: One live turn only, bounded to 120 seconds

actions.value: Use only the already configured read-only MCP tool and reply with its bounded result. Do not write to HubSpot, edit files, browse, or start a Goal.

successSignals: The read-only tool prompt is submitted once
The tool result and completed assistant response are visible within the 120-second turn bound
